verdict.rationale: VLP Law Group is a distributed law firm offering legal services such as fintech regulatory, venture capital, IP, and privacy counsel. It is not a software product or agent that could act as an MCP client, so plugging MCP servers into it is a category error. Nothing in the evidence shows any agentic or MCP-client capability that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
